# Rootly

Rootly is an AI-native incident management platform that automates workflows and collaboration, integrating with Slack, PagerDuty, and other tools to streamline incident response.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/rootly/.

## Actions

- **Delete Action Item**: This tool allows for the deletion of a specific action item in rootly.
- **Get Action Item Details** (read-only): This tool retrieves a single action item by its id from rootly using a get request to https.
- **List Action Items** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all action items for an organization in rootly.
